steps.content: Inside the dark cave, you advance slowly, feeling along the clammy, rough rock faces.

<i>Thani has fled the Bureau in haste, forgetting to remove the ankle monitor the hospital puts on all its patients. The data shows that she's snuck onto a sand ship and then jumped off mid-journey before wandering aimlessly through WhiteSands.
You've finally tracked her to this maze-like canyon cave system. Knowing she still doesn't trust you, you order your squad to wait outside while you venture in alone.
Your fingers brush against several scratches on the rock face. They're rough and hastily made, clearly left there by someone.

Despite being in WhiteSands, not even a whisper of the desert's dry air reaches inside this cave. This place is so cold and humid, it's definitely uninhabitable. Yet somehow, there are plenty of signs of human activity.
Right at your feet lies a rope trap, cunningly positioned in a deceptive spot that nearly makes you lose your balance.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Judging by the condition of the rope... this trap was set quite recently.
But since entering this cave, you haven't heard a single footstep other than your own.
While you are pondering this, you suddenly hear faint giggles coming from somewhere ahead.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Is that... a child?
You carefully step over the rope trap and enter a slightly more spacious area ahead, only to find even more traps lying in wait.
At the end of these intricate rope networks are sharpened wooden stakes, rigged to pierce any intruder who triggers the trap.
You pull out your detector and carefully navigate around these crude traps, moving toward the source of the earlier sounds.
Meanwhile, in the darkness nearby, two girls are pressed tightly into a rift in the rock face.

steps.speaker: Shura
steps.content: Come on, take the bait...

steps.speaker: Thani
steps.content: Shhh... Be patient. Though this is indeed trickier than I expected... If all else fails, I'll go out myself as bait.

steps.speaker: Shura
steps.content: No way! You only just made it back to us, Thani. You can't let those bad people catch you again... I'll do it!

steps.speaker: Thani
steps.content: Huh? Don't go out there! Wait!

steps.speaker: Shura
steps.content: Ah!
[Blank Screen] Background shakes + sound effect
A scrawny girl crashes to the ground in front of you, and you instinctively step forward. Immediately, you hear something swishing through the air.
The sound of a trap being triggered.

A wooden stick flies toward you, hitting your shoulder strap, but it's not nearly as deadly as it appears. You feel only a slight impact against your chest. The stick falls to the ground, rolling several times.

steps.speaker: Thani
steps.content: Shura! Are you okay?!

steps.speaker: Shura
steps.content: Thani! Run! Don't worry about me! My spirit will stay with you all forever!

steps.speaker: Shura
steps.content: You gray-haired fiend! If you must catch someone, take me instead!
Shura's impassioned voice echoes throughout the cave. Small pebbles occasionally sprinkle down from the ceiling, as if even the rocks are moved by her dramatic pledge of self-sacrifice.
Meanwhile, you and Thani exchange bewildered looks speechlessly.

steps.speaker: Thani
steps.content: What? It's you?! I thought it was them...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...I came here to find you.

steps.speaker: Shura
steps.content: Ugh... Thani... m-my foot really hurts...
Hearing Shura's cry, Thani rushes over immediately and helps the girl to her feet.

steps.speaker: Thani
steps.content: Let me see... I think you've sprained it. It'll probably swell up in a day. This is going to be a problem...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Here, use this for now.
You produce a small tube of ointment from your pocket and offer it to Thani. She hesitates for a moment, but eventually takes it.

steps.speaker: Thani
steps.content: Th-thank you...
Thani meticulously applies the ointment to the girl's ankle, but there's also a large patch of skin scraped off her knee that has started to bleed.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I can carry her on my back.
Thani's fingers fidget with the ointment nervously as she weighs her options.

steps.speaker: Thani
steps.content: ...All right then, please take her.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Come...
You kneel down in front of the girl. Thani helps her climb onto your back. The weight you feel is disturbingly light.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Your name is Shura, right?
The girl on your back gives a reluctant grunt of acknowledgment.

steps.speaker: Shura
steps.content: Don't think you can cozy up to me and Thani so easily, gray-haired fiend...

With Thani leading the way, the dark cave feels considerably less threatening. She moves with nimble steps, avoiding loose rocks and slippery moss underfoot, as well as the various traps her group has set.

In the darkness, the monotonous yet distinct sound of dripping water only emphasizes the cave's deathly silence. You can clearly hear your own slightly labored breathing, and the faint echo of Thani's footsteps ahead, bouncing between the rock faces.
After what feels like an eternity, finally, the space before you suddenly opens up.
[Scene Change]

You stand at the edge of a steep cliff, facing a desert stretching endlessly to the horizon. Night has already fallen, yet the moonlight is almost blindingly bright. The wind from the cave entrance carries the dryness of sand, quickly evaporating the moisture from your clothes.
You set Shura down and hear her uneven footsteps dwindle in a certain direction. Your eyes follow her to discover a group of children in tattered clothes huddled against the rock face.

steps.speaker: Thani
steps.content: I'm back!
Thani announces jubilantly. Spotting you beside her, the children study you with wary yet curious gazes.
Seeing their reaction, you open the backpack you've been carrying.

Having been wandering in WhiteSands for so long, hunger is no longer a strange sensation to Thani and her companions. Anticipating this, you specifically packed essential supplies and food before setting out.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I brought some things you might find useful.
The children stare transfixed at the food and medicine you pull out, their previous wariness forgotten as they swarm around you in an instant.
Compressed biscuits, antibiotics, bandages... All common items found in the Bureau.

steps.speaker: Thani
steps.content: Wait! I don't think you can eat that!

Thani nimbly stops a small child who has somehow snuck up beside you and was just about to gnaw on a medicine box. You sort the edible items from the inedible ones, then grab a few cans and open them for the children.
A boy is nudged forward by the others, eyeing you warily while clutching the opened cans against his chest.
He dumps the contents of the cans into a worn copper pot balanced on a few stones. Beneath it flickers a feeble flame.

steps.speaker: Thani
steps.content: That's Kash, our master chef. And that's Dima beside him. They are brother and sister.

steps.speaker: Thani
steps.content: Hehe, don't let his silence fool you! He's usually quite the chatterbox, with a temper to match!
The boy stirring the pot clearly hears Thani's comment. His lips tighten into a pout, his face glowing red in the firelight as he stirs visibly harder.
You sit with the children around the fire as the warm aroma of food fills the air, drawing small, eager murmurs from their hungry lips.
A familiar figure limps toward your group.

steps.speaker: Shura
steps.content: The soup's ready! Here you go!

steps.speaker: Shura
steps.content: This one's for Thani, and this one's for Master Fiend.
Shura even sounds a little proud, as if she's just completed an important mission.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Master Fiend...?

steps.speaker: Thani
steps.content: You should take that as a compliment!
You accept the bowl, finding the ingredients you shared earlier floating in the broth alongside a few berries.
The children cradle identical bowls, trying to savor each spoonful yet unable to resist gulping down the soup. In their crude firepit, flames continue to dance.
You take a sip. The broth is much blander than what you're used to at the Bureau. Salt is clearly a precious commodity for these children.

From across the circle, Dima watches your reaction with curious anticipation. When she catches your eye, she timidly offers you a tiny piece of bread crumb, softened from being carried close to her body.
In the firelight, Thani sits beside you, her eyes crinkling with contentment. After a while, she begins humming an Outland melody you've never heard before.
By day I bury the seeds of light, by night I gaze at the starry sky.
Winds sweep through the forgotten door, bringing songs from my faraway home...
As the song fades and the bowls empty, the children, with their bellies now full, huddle together and drift off to sleep, their breathing growing slow and steady.
You and Thani sit near the cave entrance, backs pressed against the cold rocks as you keep watch over the sleeping children.

steps.speaker: Thani
steps.content: They haven't slept this peacefully in ages. The last time was... maybe right after we left the refugee camp?
Thani speaks in a whisper, careful not to wake the children.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What about you? You look... barely older than them, yet you need to watch over everyone.

steps.speaker: Thani
steps.content: Hehe... Compared to them, I'm practically a grown-up. I promised the adults back at the refugee camp that I'd look after these kids, keep them safe.
Thani's fingers absently trace the sharpened stick resting across her knees, her makeshift weapon for self-defense.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Thani, come back with me.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Your Mania contamination is too severe. If this continues, you'll turn into a Corruptor.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: My shackles can cure you, and they'll also give you the power to truly protect these children.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You can't live like this in WhiteSands forever. Coming to DisCity would be best for all of you.

steps.speaker: Thani
steps.content: I know... But there's only one thing I care about.

steps.speaker: Thani
steps.content: We're going to be separated, right?

steps.speaker: Still, Graves nestles closer to the source of warmth, her shoulders touching the other person's as a gentle warmth passes between the two.
steps.content: ...Yes.
Thani lowers her head, avoiding your gaze.

steps.speaker: Thani
steps.content: The people at the institute once told me the same thing.
[Flashback]

steps.speaker: Fraser Researcher
steps.content: We've got your medical report.
Thani held her breath nervously. The room was suddenly devoid of noise.
After a few seconds, the researcher's face brightened with a friendly smile.

steps.speaker: Fraser Researcher
steps.content: Congratulations! Your medical results are excellent. Welcome to the Aurum Secretum Research Institute. From now on, you're an honored member of our facility.

steps.speaker: Thani
steps.content: R-really?! I can stay at the institute and perhaps one day become like Synex?

steps.speaker: Fraser Researcher
steps.content: Absolutely. We see tremendous potential in you. Who knows? You might even surpass Synex herself.

steps.speaker: Fraser Researcher
steps.content: Go ahead, place your handprint here. Someone will come for you shortly. Starting today, you're no longer just another orphan from the refugee camp.

steps.speaker: Thani
steps.content: Oh, but what does that mean? I am from the refugee camp.

steps.speaker: Fraser Researcher
steps.content: It means you don't have to go back to that miserable life of never knowing when you can have your next meal. Here, we'll provide you with nutritious food and medical care, and we'll nurture you into someone exceptional.

steps.speaker: Thani
steps.content: What if... I want to go back?

steps.speaker: Fraser Researcher
steps.content: Oh dear, that would be a problem. According to our protocols, once you're part of the institute, you can't go back.

steps.speaker: Thani
steps.content: ...But that's no trouble at all! I know the way! I can go back by myself...

steps.speaker: Fraser Researcher
steps.content: No, you cannot go back, and you can never contact anyone from the refugee camp again. Those are the rules, and even I have no say in the matter. Just settle in here. Don't you want to become like Synex? She once went through the exact same thing.

steps.speaker: Fraser Researcher
steps.content: Don't look so glum. Think about it, do you really want to go back to the refugee camp? Do you really miss the constant hunger, the endless fear that the next minor ailment might finally kill you?

steps.speaker: Fraser Researcher
steps.content: And those people at the camp? Nothing but lazy parasites. If they found out how special you are, they'd use every trick to exploit you until there's nothing left.

Thani's fist tightened with each word from the researcher, until her fingers brushed against several syringes hidden beneath the sheets, supplies she'd secretly stashed away and was hoping to sneak back to the refugee camp.
She pulled one out.

steps.speaker: Thani
steps.content: ...Take this!

steps.speaker: Fraser Researcher
steps.content: What did you just throw... Hey! Wait!

steps.speaker: Fraser Researcher
steps.content: Help needed at Lab No. 4: Test Subject #1672 has attacked staff and escaped. Do not let her out of the facility! In case of resistance, lethal force is authorized!
[Scene Change]

steps.speaker: Female Refugee
steps.content: Thani! Why are you here? Aren't you supposed to be at the institute?

steps.speaker: Thani
steps.content: Auntie Isha! Please, keep your voice down... I barely managed to escape.

steps.speaker: Male Refugee
steps.content: What?! You silly girl, you made it to the institute! Why on earth would you run away? If you're selected, you could become like Synex!

steps.speaker: Thani
steps.content: But the people there...!
Thani's voice cut off abruptly. She couldn't bring herself to repeat those words. Facing the concerned looks of those she considered family, she picked and chose her words carefully.

steps.speaker: Thani
steps.content: They said a lot of mean things about the refugee camp... And they told me that according to the rules, I could never come back or see any of you again...

steps.speaker: Thani
steps.content: Even if they could really cure me, what's the point of a better life if I have to live it all alone...

steps.speaker: Thani
steps.content: Besides, my condition hasn't been an entirely bad thing! I wouldn't have escaped without it. If it really comes to that... I can try to sneak back in there again!
After hearing Thani's answer, the two exchanged a glance, but neither could find the words to respond.

steps.speaker: Thani
steps.content: Anyway, enough about that. Look what I smuggled out! You could use some of this medicine, right, Auntie Isha? And this bag here is full of Aurum Secretum fragments I collected on my way out. The institute is really loaded with useful stuff!
[Back to Reality]

steps.speaker: Thani
steps.content: That night, everyone in the camp brought out their best ingredients and made a huge pot of soup for me. I hadn't done anything special, yet they treated me like I was one of those important people from the institute.

steps.speaker: Thani
steps.content: The researchers were wrong. Everyone at the camp was so kind... If I'd stayed at the facility, how would I ever taste such wonderful soup again? And besides, I would've been turned into... a monster...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But the Bureau...

steps.speaker: Thani
steps.content: I know what you're going to say. The Bureau is different.
Thani shakes her head firmly.

steps.speaker: Thani
steps.content: Even if what you're saying is true, I still won't leave them. Even if it means I can't get my treatment, even if we have to wander in WhiteSands forever...

steps.speaker: Thani
steps.content: Because... I made them a promise. I'll always stay by their side, no matter what.
Thani lowers her eyes, purses her lips, and speaks slowly.

steps.speaker: Thani
steps.content: I have these dreams all the time. Dreams where everyone's still here. Dreams of us gathering wild berries together, playing pranks on neighbors, telling jokes to the elderly. You see, they didn't have a good memory, so they'd laugh at the same jokes no matter how many times we told them.

steps.speaker: Thani
steps.content: Often, these beautiful dreams terrify me more than nightmares ever could.

steps.speaker: Thani
steps.content: All this time, we only managed to survive in WhiteSands by staying together as a family. But now...

steps.speaker: Thani
steps.content: That's why I promised them I wouldn't let anything tear us apart again.
You remain silent for a moment, then slowly nod.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: As Chief of the Bureau, I still hope you'll come to DisCity. It would be safest for all of you. But I'll give you time to think about it. Until then, I'll stay with you. WhiteSands are too dangerous.
You give her a smile.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: And I want to thank you. For trusting me tonight.
Thani scratches the back of her head, looking somewhat embarrassed.

steps.speaker: Thani
steps.content: Actually... I noticed you had a bunch of good stuff on you, so I figured I'd just grab whatever you had first and worry about the rest later...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I see...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Hmm, and who just told me not long ago that they were robbed clean by desert bandits? The pot's calling the kettle black, huh?

steps.speaker: Thani
steps.content: But I didn't actually do it! It was just a fleeting thought...
She grumbles under her breath, but the next moment, she suddenly freezes. Her body tenses and her back goes rigid, as if she's detected something in the darkness.
Your chest tightens as you leap to your feet, instinctively positioning yourself between the girl and whatever danger lurks nearby.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What's the matter?

steps.speaker: Thani
steps.content: Those people... I think they've found us again!
You follow her gaze out toward the desert. The once-peaceful WhiteSands now reveals threatening silhouettes against the night sky.
In the shadows of jagged rock formations, two dark figures are silently scaling the steep cliff face.

Your breathing grows heavier as you watch them. Their movements are cautious yet expertly efficient, creating not even the faintest sound. Time is running out. They could appear before you at any moment.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Get the children to safety!

Thani nods anxiously, grabbing her wooden stick and tapping it against the ground several times. The children jolt awake, their drowsy eyes filled with confusion and the dawning recognition of danger.

steps.speaker: Thani
steps.content: Follow me! Everyone into the cave!
Thani herds the children forward, dragging and pushing them into the pitch-black cave.
Meanwhile, you dash to the opposite side of the cave entrance, away from where the children fled. You quickly turn on your comms device and transmit your current coordinates.
After completing these steps, you bend down to grab an empty can and hurl it forcefully against a jutting rock below the cave entrance.
[Empty Shot]
The climbing figures below freeze momentarily, then immediately change course, accelerating directly toward your position.

The lead assassin reaches the ledge's edge in seconds. In one fluid motion, he hoists himself up onto the ledge. Moonlight glints off the blade in his hand. He crouches low, muscles tensed, and lunges toward you.
[Empty Shot]
With a sharp crack, warm blood splatters all over your face.
The assassin before you clutches his wrist, staggering backward a few steps.
And standing beside you is Thani.
She grips the sharpened wooden stick tightly in her hand, her eyes full of feigned calmness while her body trembles slightly.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Thani! Go hide with the others!

steps.speaker: Thani
steps.content: You won't last long on your own... Every second we can buy counts!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But you're not strong enough...
Your warning is cut short. The other assassin has silently landed on the ledge, his dagger slicing through the air toward your ribs. You twist away, the blade grazing your shoulder.
Your shoulder strap blocks the blow once again, but this time, the leather splits and blood seeps from your shoulder.

As you dodge the strike, the first assassin regains his footing. Abandoning his fallen knife, he pulls an even smaller dagger from his boot and lunges toward Thani, who has her back turned to him while anxiously watching your fight.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Thani! Behind you!
In that critical moment, Thani does something unexpected. Instead of dodging, she swings her wooden stick with all her might at the assassin's legs while using the momentum to fling herself backward.
[Blank Screen] Screen shakes + impact sound effect
Her back slams hard against the rock face.
You rush to her side, hoping to at least shield one side of her body from further attacks.

steps.speaker: Thani
steps.content: I... I'm okay...
Despite her words, her body is clearly at its breaking point.

Slowly closing in on you, the assassins drag their blades across the rocks, the metal making ear-splitting screeches. Each scrape feels like a knife thrust to Thani. Her legs shake violently, ready to give out at any moment.
Suddenly, one of them throws something at the rock face beside you, creating an explosive bang.

steps.speaker: Thani
steps.content: ...Ahhh!
Thani's knees slam to the ground as her stick rolls off. She clamps her hands over her ears and curls into a ball.
Unable to cause any direct injuries, they're now trying to break Thani's mind by torturing her senses.
At this rate, you won't last until rescue arrives. You must use your shackles on Thani now, if only to temporarily relieve her amplified pain.
You reach out to Thani, but a sword suddenly flies at you both. With a flick of your wrist, you attempt to catch it.
But it slices your palm, cutting into your flesh. The blade, now slick with your blood, doesn't slow down at all, but glides straight toward Thani.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Watch out!
Right then, a tiny shadow emerges.
[Screen Shake Effect]

steps.speaker: Thani
steps.content: Shura!
